title: Barista: Hey! What can I get...
content_text:
Barista: Hey! What can I get you today?

Leo: Hi! Can I get an iced oat latte, please? And maybe a pastry or something — what do you recommend?

Barista: The banana muffin is really popular. It just came out of the oven like ten minutes ago.

Leo: Oh, sold! I'll take one of those too.

Barista: Nice choice. For here or to go?

Leo: For here. I'm gonna camp out for a bit — got some work to do.

Barista: No worries, we've got free Wi-Fi. Password's on the wall behind you. Oh, and plug's under the bench if you need to charge.

Leo: Awesome, thanks. By the way, is it always this chill here?

Barista: Pretty much! Mornings are quiet, it picks up around noon. You should grab a spot near the window — best light and less foot traffic.

Leo: Good tip. I'll do that. How long have you been working here?

Barista: About six months. I moved here from Sydney — couldn't stand the winter anymore.

Leo: Ha, I get that. I'm thinking about basing myself here for a couple months actually.

Barista: Dude, do it. A lot of remoters come through here. You'll fit right in.
